t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone reading sheet. Top-left: a small sans eyebrow and a large light-weight navy sans-serif headline in sentence case. Left two thirds: an open-sided three-column table with navy hairline rules and five numbered rows with mono numerals, holding <CONTENT>. Right: a grey hairline isometric line drawing of a long equipment skid frame with tube profiles, cropped by the top and right edges so it bleeds off the page. Flat, no shading, square corners, calm and practical.
signature_idea: A plain numbered terms table with an isometric skid frame drawing bleeding off the right edge as a quiet backdrop.
strengths: light headline, mono numerals and limestone sheet fit the brand
table is readable with generous row spacing
bleeding skid drawing adds equipment context without competing
easy to build from existing table and illustration parts
weaknesses: mostly a plain table with a backdrop drawing, little visual idea
the requested navy band is missing, so there is no navy-limestone alternation
skid shows aluminium-profile framing and gas-bottle-like cylinders, not a PP water skid
invented commercial terms (percentages, validity, warranty) read as real offers
hype phrases in notes break the brand voice
black chat-title bar from the capture overlaps the bottom-left
brand_fit_why: Limestone, light headline, mono numerals, hairline rules and square corners fit, but no navy or accent and an off-offer skid drawing.
